classifierSummary.thisIsNotARasterMeasurement: Byte classification only. Over-suppression -- ink the official form itself draws that a remedy removed -- is invisible here and is caught only by a directional raster difference against a render of the pinned source, read in both directions.
classifierSummary.grantsNothing: A classification is a measurement. It sets no verdict, issues no PASS and authorizes no rebuild.
